snippet.title: Carmilla : Crimson Moon | Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The dark gothic yuri novel Carmilla : Crimson Moon releases June 23rd on Steam. Play as Laura, the beautiful lady in the Castle who is can't keep her eyes off the a mysterious new guest Carmilla.
